description: The copies a file has on usb disks already reach its level: --move-originals makes no copy, and the user copy on a sata disk hands its part to the first of them, which becomes the user copy, then goes to the trash as rebalance.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
tags = ["sata"]
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"
tags = ["usb"]
[[disk]]
id = "t3"
uuid = "4f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t3"
fs = "ext4"
tags = ["usb"]
[defaults]
replicas = 2

steps.query: SELECT disk_id, created_by, state FROM copies ORDER BY disk_id
